title: supported PASS count and the reclassification of unsupported PASS rows
authority: single owner == issuer, owner order 2026-11-01 (unattended Native E2E round)
ruling: A PASS counts as supported only when a row-specific artefact binds it (path names the work order, or C:/wg/queue/<WP>/output).
Family-level manifests that name many work orders are NOT evidence for any single row; the audit v1 heuristic that produced 11+6 such bindings is withdrawn.
The 16 rows listed in reclassified_unsupported_pass keep their historical state but carry no supported claim; they must be re-bound or re-executed before any round reports them as PASS.
The supported PASS count for this queue is 3 (WP-FHS-10, WP-FHS-11, WP-FHS-17); FAIL rows WP-FHS-12, WP-FHS-13, WP-FHS-20 are unaffected by this ruling.
No row is deleted, no verdict is upgraded, and no evidence_ref is invented.
